svg.text: euvd/history.jsonl: one line per day written by this monitor, because the EUVD keeps no history of these values: size of the exploited set, size of the EUVD, entries
seen by the honeypot sensors, their connections and the number flagged UPTICK.

g.text: entries flagged UPTICK per day (recorded from 9 October 2026)

svg.text: 30 days recorded, 7 Oct 2026 to 6 Nov 2026. The exploited set went from 1,747 to 1,786 entries; honeypot connections across all entries from
95,708 to 94,786 a day; the EUVD flagged 122 entries UPTICK on the last day.
Limits: Starts on the day the monitor began recording; nothing before that can be reconstructed. A missing day means the monitor did not run, not that nothing
